 # check and place green

reveal

##### guess 2 - from chatgpt

# Start with all possible words
possible_words <- words

for (i in 1:5) {

  if (reveal[i] == "green") {

    # Green: letter must be in the same position
    possible_words <- possible_words[
      substr(possible_words, i, i) == guess[[1]][i]
    ]

  } else if (reveal[i] == "yellow") {

    # Yellow: letter must be in the word, but not this position
    possible_words <- possible_words[
      grepl(guess[[1]][i], possible_words) &
      substr(possible_words, i, i) != guess[[1]][i]
    ]

  } else {

    # Grey: letter cannot be in the word
    possible_words <- possible_words[
      !grepl(guess[[1]][i], possible_words)
    ]

  }
}

# Randomly select a possible second guess
guess2 <- sample(possible_words, 1)

guess2

# First Strategy: Complete Randomness

Out of all legal words, how often do you win by making guesses that have no influence on other guesses?

```{r}
absolute_randomness <- function(){
  guesses <- c()
  answer_random <- sample(words, 1)
  for (i in 1:6){
    guesses[i] <- sample(words, 1)
  }
  if (any(guesses == answer_random)){
    return(TRUE)
  }
  else{
  return(FALSE)
  }
}

nsim <- 10000
(sum(replicate(nsim, absolute_randomness())) / nsim)
guesses
```

```{r}

library(stringr)

# Setup target word and first guess
target_word <- random[1]
first_guess <- random[2]

cat("Target Answer", target_word, "\n\n")

target_letters <- str_split(target_word, pattern = "")[[1]]
guess_letters <- str_split(first_guess, pattern = "")[[1]]

# Track valid letters and position feedback
valid_letters <- letters
feedback <- character(5)

# 1. Evaluate the first guess (Green, Yellow, Grey)
for (i in 1:5) {
  if (guess_letters[i] == target_letters[i]) {
    feedback[i] <- "green"
  } else if (guess_letters[i] %in% target_letters) {
    feedback[i] <- "yellow"
  } else {
    feedback[i] <- "grey"
  }
}

  cat("Guess 1:", first_guess, "\n")
  cat("Colors: ", paste(feedback, collapse = " "), "\n\n")

# 2. Remove grey letters from valid_letters
for (i in 1:5) {
  if (feedback[i] == "grey") {
    valid_letters <- valid_letters[valid_letters != guess_letters[i]]
  }
}

# Identify all letters marked yellow so we make sure to keep using them
yellow_letters <- guess_letters[feedback == "yellow"]

# 3. Filter the word list for valid second guesses
remaining_words <- c()

for (word in words) {
  candidate_letters <- str_split(as.character(word), pattern = "")[[1]]
  
  # Rule A: Word must only contain valid (non-grey) letters
  uses_valid_letters <- all(candidate_letters %in% valid_letters)
  
  # Rule B: Word must include all discovered yellow letters
  includes_yellows <- all(yellow_letters %in% candidate_letters)
  
  # Rule C: Yellow letters cannot be in the exact same spot as before
  yellow_spot_clash <- FALSE
  for (i in 1:5) {
    if (feedback[i] == "yellow" && candidate_letters[i] == guess_letters[i]) {
      yellow_spot_clash <- TRUE
      break
    }
  }
  # Rule D: Green letters MUST stay locked in their exact spot
  green_spot_mismatch <- FALSE
  for (i in 1:5) {
    if (feedback[i] == "green" && candidate_letters[i] != guess_letters[i]) {
      green_spot_mismatch <- TRUE
      break
    }
  }
  
  # Keep the word only if it passes all rules
  if (uses_valid_letters && includes_yellows && !yellow_spot_clash) {
    remaining_words <- c(remaining_words, word)
  }
}

# 4. Pick the second guess
second_guess <- sample(remaining_words, 1)
second_guess_letters <- str_split(second_guess, pattern = "")[[1]]
feedback_2 <- character(5)

for (i in 1:5) {
  if (second_guess_letters[i] == target_letters[i]) {
    feedback_2[i] <- "green"
  } else if (second_guess_letters[i] %in% target_letters) {
    feedback_2[i] <- "yellow"
  } else {
    feedback_2[i] <- "grey"
  }
}

#Print guess 2 and its colors
cat("Guess 2:", second_guess, "\n")
cat("Colors: ", paste(feedback_2, collapse = " "), "\n")
```

```{r}
library(stringr)

simulate_wordle <- function(words, target_word = NULL, first_guess = NULL, max_guesses = 6, verbose = TRUE) {
  # Ensure words are clean lowercase character strings
  words <- tolower(as.character(words))
  
  # Pick random target and first guess if not provided
  if (is.null(target_word)) target_word <- sample(words, 1)
  if (is.null(first_guess)) first_guess <- sample(words, 1)
  
  target_letters <- str_split(target_word, pattern = "")[[1]]
  valid_letters <- letters
  remaining_words <- words
  
  if (verbose) {
    cat("Target Answer:", target_word, "\n\n")
  }
  
  current_guess <- first_guess
  guess_history <- character()
  
  for (turn in 1:max_guesses) {
    guess_letters <- str_split(current_guess, pattern = "")[[1]]
    feedback <- character(5)
    
    # 1. Evaluate the current guess (Green, Yellow, Grey)
    for (i in 1:5) {
      if (guess_letters[i] == target_letters[i]) {
        feedback[i] <- "green"
      } else if (guess_letters[i] %in% target_letters) {
        feedback[i] <- "yellow"
      } else {
        feedback[i] <- "grey"
      }
    }
    
    guess_history <- c(guess_history, current_guess)
    
    if (verbose) {
      cat("Guess", turn, ":", current_guess, "\n")
      cat("Colors: ", paste(feedback, collapse = " "), "\n\n")
    }
    
    # Stop early if all 5 letters are green
    if (all(feedback == "green")) {
      if (verbose) cat("Solved in", turn, "guesses!\n")
      return(list(
        target = target_word,
        solved = TRUE,
        num_guesses = turn,
        guesses = guess_history
      ))
    }
    
    # 2. Update valid letters (only remove grey if it's not green/yellow elsewhere in the guess)
    active_letters <- guess_letters[feedback %in% c("green", "yellow")]
    for (i in 1:5) {
      if (feedback[i] == "grey" && !(guess_letters[i] %in% active_letters)) {
        valid_letters <- valid_letters[valid_letters != guess_letters[i]]
      }
    }
    
    yellow_letters <- guess_letters[feedback == "yellow"]
    
    # 3. Filter remaining_words for the next turn
    next_remaining <- c()
    
    for (word in remaining_words) {
      # Don't re-guess the exact word we just tried
      if (word == current_guess) next
      
      candidate_letters <- str_split(word, pattern = "")[[1]]
      
      # Rule A: Only valid (non-grey) letters
      uses_valid_letters <- all(candidate_letters %in% valid_letters)
      
      # Rule B: Includes all discovered yellow letters
      includes_yellows <- all(yellow_letters %in% candidate_letters)
      
      # Rule C: Yellow letters cannot be in the same spot
      yellow_spot_clash <- FALSE
      for (i in 1:5) {
        if (feedback[i] == "yellow" && candidate_letters[i] == guess_letters[i]) {
          yellow_spot_clash <- TRUE
          break
        }
      }
      
      # Rule D: Green letters stay locked in place
      green_spot_mismatch <- FALSE
      for (i in 1:5) {
        if (feedback[i] == "green" && candidate_letters[i] != guess_letters[i]) {
          green_spot_mismatch <- TRUE
          break
        }
      }
      
      if (uses_valid_letters && includes_yellows && !yellow_spot_clash && !green_spot_mismatch) {
        next_remaining <- c(next_remaining, word)
      }
    }
    
    remaining_words <- next_remaining
    
    # Safety check in case no valid words remain
    if (length(remaining_words) == 0) break
    
    # 4. Pick the next guess (handle single-element vector safely in sample())
    if (length(remaining_words) == 1) {
      current_guess <- remaining_words[1]
    } else {
      current_guess <- sample(remaining_words, 1)
    }
  }
  
  if (verbose) cat("Failed to solve within", max_guesses, "guesses.\n")
  
  return(list(
    target = target_word,
    solved = FALSE,
    num_guesses = NA,
    guesses = guess_history
  ))
}

simulate_wordle(words, verbose = TRUE)
```
